title: Design Google Docs
definition: Google Docs requires extreme expertise in DOM manipulation (often utilizing `<canvas>` or `contenteditable`), and Operational Transformation (OT) or CRDT algorithms over WebSockets to sync cursor positions and text edits simultaneously across users.
simpleExplanation: A word processor where 50 people can type on the exact same line at the exact same time without the text getting jumbled or crashing the server.

basic: What are the core requirements for Google Docs?
intermediate: How do you handle edge cases and accessibility in Google Docs?
advanced: How do you scale and optimize Google Docs for millions of concurrent users?
trick: What happens to Google Docs if JavaScript is disabled?

answers.question: Define Google Docs.
answers.answer: A complex system design problem requiring deep architectural knowledge.

graph TD

  OT -->|Broadcasts State| ClientA
  OT -->|Broadcasts State| ClientB
